P7-WARM-1_cold_t1.description: Cold model load from disk into GPU VRAM
P7-WARM-1_cold_t1.timer_start_boundary: Ollama API model load / generation invocation
P7-WARM-1_cold_t1.timer_end_boundary: Model weights fully mapped into GPU VRAM

P7-WARM-2_warm_t1.description: Warm model request while resident via keep_alive
P7-WARM-2_warm_t1.timer_start_boundary: Request submission to resident Ollama endpoint

P7-WARM-3_warm_reuse.description: Sequential request on active resident model (model reload penalty)
P7-WARM-3_warm_reuse.timer_start_boundary: Subsequent query dispatch to existing resident model
P7-WARM-3_warm_reuse.reload_latency_note: Model reload latency is <0.001 s (below measurable timer threshold); request latency still incurs prompt eval and token generation

P7-WARM-4_t1_t2_switch.description: Model switch cost between T1 and T2 on 6GB VRAM (requires sequential unload/load)
P7-WARM-4_t1_t2_switch.timer_end_boundary: T2 model weights fully resident in VRAM
P7-WARM-4_t1_t2_switch.reason: Combined VRAM demand exceeds 6,144 MiB physical capacity

policy_decision.justification: Prewarming is beneficial for eliminating the 11.781s cold-load delay when the route is known, but concurrent residency of multiple models is strictly prohibited to prevent VRAM overflow.
